set.body: From S7.6. The Analysis board's preflight shows 'pairs ≤ 50,000 · cells ≤ 20M', but neither the recipe nor the protocol carries a budget, so the row is omitted rather than invented. Decide who owns the budget (a studio rule or an eyes4s plan limit), and serve it.
set.title: Preflight budget row: declare a pairs/cells budget in the recipe or protocol
